newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - September 19.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - September 19.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had one large one-day net miss in its reserve projections on Tuesday causing more reserves than anticipated primarily due to deposits being lower at the Federal Reserve Bank, a Fed spokesman said.

As for the pattern of borrowing, about 73 percent of the adjustment borrowing for the week was done by the small banks, while about 27 percent was done by the large regionals. No borrowing was done by the money center banks.
As for the pattern of borrowing on Wednesday, 20 percent of the borrowing was done by the small banks, while 80 percent was done by the large regionals. No borrowing was done by the money centers.
The high in natural float was about $1.4 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about $400 million on Friday.
Transportation float averaged about $50 million per day with the high on Wednesday at about $150 million primarily due to aircraft delays in the Northeast because of weather problems.
